name: One Global Company Check
Employee Sub ID's Generation
Master Employee ID Generator
Contact CRM ID Generator
script:
# ONLY run this logic if the document is brand new and unsaved
if doc.get("__islocal"):
    
    # Check if the user selected an Access Entity (Company)
    if doc.custom_access_entity:
        
        # 1. Fetch the official Company Abbreviation
        company_abbr = frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.custom_access_entity, "abbr")
        
        if company_abbr:
            comp_prefix = company_abbr.strip().upper()
            
            # 2. Get today's date safely (Returns format 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            raw_date = frappe.utils.nowdate() 
            
            # 3. Manually slice it into YYMMDD to bypass the security sandbox
            # '2026-05-26' -> splits into ['2026', '05', '26']
            parts = raw_date.split("-")
            # Take last 2 digits of year + month + day
            date_str = parts[0][2:] + parts[1] + parts[2] 
            
            # Combine them to create today's exact search prefix (e.g., "AQH-260526-")
            search_prefix = f"{comp_prefix}-{date_str}-"
            
            # 4. Ask the database for all contracts created TODAY for THIS company
            existing_contracts = frappe.get_all(
                "Contract",
                filters={"name": ("like", f"{search_prefix}%")},
                pluck="name"
            )
            
            # 5. Do the math! Find the highest number used today and add 1
            if existing_contracts:
                numbers = []
                for cid in existing_contracts:
                    if cid:
                        try:
                            # Split by dash and look at the very last part (the 001)
                            num = int(cid.split("-")[-1])
                            numbers.append(num)
                        except:
                            pass
                next_num = max(numbers) + 1 if numbers else 1
            else:
                # If this is the very first contract for this company today, start at 1
                next_num = 1
                
            # 6. Format it perfectly (e.g., AQH-260526-001)
            final_id = f"{search_prefix}{str(next_num).zfill(3)}"
            
            # 7. Override Frappe's hidden backend database ID
            doc.name = final_id
            
            # 8. Push it into your read-only UI field!
            doc.custom_custom_contact_id = final_id

cycle_name = (doc.appraisal_cycle or "").lower()
state = doc.workflow_state or "Pending"

is_mid = "mid" in cycle_name or "half" in cycle_name
is_ann = "annual" in cycle_name

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 1: We are updating the MID-TERM appraisal
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if is_mid:
    obj_stat = "Pending"
    mid_stat = "Pending"
    
    # Calculate exactly what the Mid-Term statuses should be
    if state == "Objective Review Pending":
        obj_stat = "Under Review"
    elif state in ["Objectives Approved", "Objectives Rejected"]:
        obj_stat = "Approved"
    elif state == "Pending Manager Review":
        obj_stat = "Approved"
        mid_stat = "Manager Review"
    elif state == "Completed":
        obj_stat = "Approved"
        mid_stat = "Completed"
        
    # Set them on this Mid-Term document
    doc.custom_objective_status = obj_stat
    doc.custom_midterm_status = mid_stat
    doc.custom_annual_status = "N/A"
    
    # Push these fresh updates instantly to any existing Annual appraisal
    annuals = frappe.get_all("Appraisal", filters={"employee": doc.employee, "name": ["!=", doc.name], "docstatus": ["<", 2]}, fields=["name", "appraisal_cycle", "workflow_state"])
    for a in annuals:
        if "annual" in (a.get("appraisal_cycle") or "").lower():
            ann_st = "N/A"
            if mid_stat == "Completed":
                astate = a.get("workflow_state") or "Pending"
                if astate in ["Draft", "Pending"]: ann_st = "Pending"
                elif astate == "Pending Manager Review": ann_st = "Manager Review"
                elif astate == "Completed": ann_st = "Completed"
            
            # Force the Annual document in the database to update its columns!
            frappe.db.set_value("Appraisal", a.name, {
                "custom_objective_status": obj_stat,
                "custom_midterm_status": mid_stat,
                "custom_annual_status": ann_st
            })

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 2: We are updating or creating an ANNUAL appraisal
# ---------------------------------------------------------
elif is_ann:
    # Look back at the Mid-Term's actual workflow state history
    past = frappe.get_all("Appraisal", filters={"employee": doc.employee, "name": ["!=", doc.name], "docstatus": ["<", 2]}, fields=["name", "appraisal_cycle", "workflow_state"], order_by="creation desc")
    
    m_obj = "Pending"
    m_mid = "Pending"
    
    for p in past:
        if "mid" in (p.get("appraisal_cycle") or "").lower() or "half" in (p.get("appraisal_cycle") or "").lower():
            p_state = p.get("workflow_state") or "Pending"
            if p_state == "Objective Review Pending":
                m_obj = "Under Review"
            elif p_state in ["Objectives Approved", "Objectives Rejected"]:
                m_obj = "Approved"
            elif p_state == "Pending Manager Review":
                m_obj = "Approved"
                m_mid = "Manager Review"
            elif p_state == "Completed":
                m_obj = "Approved"
                m_mid = "Completed"
            break
            
    doc.custom_objective_status = m_obj
    doc.custom_midterm_status = m_mid
    
    # Calculate Annual Status
    if m_mid != "Completed":
        doc.custom_annual_status = "N/A"
    else:
        if state in ["Draft", "Pending"]: doc.custom_annual_status = "Pending"
        elif state == "Pending Manager Review": doc.custom_annual_status = "Manager Review"
        elif state == "Completed": doc.custom_annual_status = "Completed"
